Author: Xsyy
Description:
[size=4][color=#BBDAC8]Requested by Harold45[/color][/size]
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]Simple Ferngill Gear[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Weapons and field supplies for your next trip into the mines.[/size][/center]

[size=5][color=#D8B4FE]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/size]

[size=4]Add 30 Ferngill-inspired items: seven melee weapons, five ranged weapons, three ammunition types, three MREs, four soups, four water bottles, two snacks and two pairs of boots. Unlock equipment through Guild membership, skills, mine progress and Kent’s friendship.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]📖 Getting Started[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Items are not added to your inventory automatically.[/b] Install the folders listed below, launch through SMAPI, then visit Gus at the Stardrop Saloon or Marlon at the Adventurer’s Guild during their shop hours.

[b]Start with Gus’s Water Bottle for 50g.[/b] At Foraging 1, his 250g Field Ration recipe makes two rations from 2 Wheat + 1 fruit through the crafting menu, with no kitchen needed. At Foraging 2, buy the 500g Simple Soup recipe and cook it in a kitchen. Kent’s three MRE recipes arrive by mail after meeting their friendship and progression requirements.

Guild membership, base skill levels, friendship and learned recipes are personal. Mine-floor gates use the deepest floor reached by any farmer on the farm. Temporary skill buffs do not unlock stock. Prepared food portions appear after learning their recipes and meeting the other listed gates.[/size]

[b]Bows:[/b] hold the tool/left mouse button to draw fully, then release to fire. Scout and Ranger draw times are 800ms and 1,100ms.

Learn each recipe before crafting its weapon or ammunition through the normal crafting menu. Each weapon recipe makes one weapon; each ammunition recipe makes 20. All 30 items, unlocks, prices and recipes are also listed in the included [b]Getting-Started.txt[/b].[/size]

[/table][size=5][b][color=#F2C879]📬 MRE recipes — Kent[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Kent sends each recipe in [b]Year 2 or later[/b] after the listed requirements are met. Eligible mail arrives the next day; open the letter to learn the recipe, then use a kitchen. These recipes are not sold by a shop.

[b]04 — Ferngill Meal Ready to Eat:[/b] 8 hearts with Kent. Cook 1 fruit + 2 vegetables + 1 Coffee. Restores 200 energy / 90 health; +10% melee damage for about 5m 36s.

[b]13 — Super MRE:[/b] 10 hearts with Kent and the original MRE recipe known. Cook 1 MRE + 1 Cheese + 1 Triple Shot Espresso. Restores 280 energy / 126 health; +15% melee damage for about 10 minutes.

[b]17 — Deluxe MRE:[/b] 10 hearts with Kent, Super MRE recipe known, base Combat 8 and shared mine floor 120. Cook 1 Super MRE + 1 Goat Cheese + 1 Oil. Restores 320 energy / 144 health; +20% melee damage for about 12 minutes.

The three MREs share the normal food-buff slot and [b]replace one another rather than stacking[/b]. A separate drink effect remains separate. Their melee bonuses do not amplify ranged projectile damage. Coffee or Espresso ingredients do not transfer their own Speed buff into the meal. Ordinary soups, snacks and water have no temporary stat buff.

Category ingredients accept valid fruit or vegetables, including mixed stacks. Native quality selection and seasoning apply. The seven cooking recipes count toward applicable cooking completion requirements.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#A6D3F5]🎯 Load and use the pistol[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Default PC mouse controls:[/b]
1. Buy the FRG-1 Pistol and some Basic Ammunition from Marlon, or craft the rounds after learning their recipe.
2. Open your inventory. Left-click the ammunition stack to pick it up, then [b]right-click the pistol's inventory slot[/b] to attach the ammunition. Merely carrying rounds elsewhere in your backpack does not load the pistol.
3. Put the pistol on your hotbar, close the inventory and select it.
4. Point the mouse where you want to aim. [b]Left-click to fire[/b], or hold left-click for repeated shots. A loaded click fires immediately; shots are spaced 0.6 seconds apart.
5. If the magazine is empty, click to begin loading. Keep the pistol selected and wait about [b]1.6 seconds[/b]. It loads up to [b]6 available rounds[/b]. Extra clicks do not restart the reload, and you may release the mouse while waiting. Held fire resumes once ready; releasing never fires a completion shot.

[b]Read the magazine indicator:[/b] Ready means you can shoot. Reloading means wait for loading to finish. Cycling is the short pause between shots. No ammo means attach more Basic Ammunition. Click to reload means begin loading the empty magazine.

There is [b]no added R-key reload[/b]. Only Basic Ammunition is accepted. Each shot consumes one physical round, and fired rounds cannot be recovered. The pistol does not create ammunition.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]📦 Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]For all [b]30 items[/b], install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16767]Archery 3.0.2[/url] separately. Frameworks are not bundled.

Extract these seven folders into your game’s Mods folder:
[CP] Simple Ferngill Gear
[SMAPI] Simple Ferngill Gear Meal Display
[SMAPI] Simple Ferngill Gear Melee Visuals
[Archery] Simple Ferngill Gear
[CP] Simple Ferngill Gear Archery Shops
[SMAPI] Simple Ferngill Gear Rendering
[SMAPI] Simple Ferngill Gear Ranged Support

For the [b]22 core items without ranged weapons and ammunition[/b], install only the first three folders with SMAPI and Content Patcher. The core meal and melee components do not need Archery. Do not remove Archery while retaining its items in a save.

Launch through SMAPI. Replace old matching mod folders instead of keeping duplicates, and avoid nested copies. Back up your save before changing mods. The download includes [b]Getting-Started.txt[/b] with the complete item, recipe and control guide.

[b]If an item is missing:[/b] check SMAPI for missing requirements or duplicate folders, shop hours, personal Guild/base-skill/recipe gates and shared mine progress. Kent’s mail arrives after an eligible overnight check. For firing, check attached ammunition, magazine status and reload progress; switching away can interrupt loading.[/size]

[size=4][b]Replacing an older Ferngill download?[/b] Close the game, remove the seven old Ferngill module folders, then extract the seven matching Simple Ferngill Gear folders from this download. Do not keep both sets: they share stable mod IDs. Item IDs, recipes and save data are unchanged. See the included [b]Folder-Migration.txt[/b] for the exact old-to-new folder list.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]🌍 Compatibility and languages[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Tested on PC Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, Content Patcher 2.9.1 and Archery 3.0.2. Pistol support targets Archery 3.0.2 and disables its changes with a warning if a different or incompatible framework is detected.

Includes English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian, with English fallback. Translations are not native-speaker certified. Archery may append its own English '+0 Damage' ammunition tooltip suffix.

Android, physical-controller use, connected multiplayer, optional appearance frameworks and every modpack combination have not been verified. Other mods can change shops, buffs or Archery damage.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]Removal[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Back up your save first. Remove or sell these items from inventories, equipment, attachments and storage before uninstalling. Removing content may leave missing items or recipe records; no automatic save-cleaning tool is included.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Please include a SMAPI log, game/framework versions, what you did and what happened. Screenshots help with visual problems. Avoid sharing personal save data publicly.[/size]

Manifest.Description: Five ranged weapons and three finite ammunition types for the separate Archery framework.
Manifest.Author: xSyy

Manifest.Name: Simple Ferngill Gear - Core
Manifest.Description: Seven melee weapons, meals, soups, water, snacks and boots with native shops, recipes and progression.
Manifest.Author: xSyy

Manifest.Name: Simple Ferngill Gear - Ranged Shops
Manifest.Description: Adds the ranged weapons, ammunition and crafting recipes to Marlon's shop.
Manifest.Author: xSyy

Manifest.Name: Simple Ferngill Gear - Meal Display
Manifest.Description: Displays the native10,15 and20 percent Ferngill meal bonuses independently of Archery.
Manifest.Author: xSyy

Manifest.Name: Simple Ferngill Gear - Melee Visuals
Manifest.Description: Keeps the Poleaxe cutting head facing correctly during native held animations.
Manifest.Author: xSyy

Manifest.Name: Simple Ferngill Gear - Ranged Support
Manifest.Description: Native bow/crossbow projectile alignment, nocked arrows and resale values for the four Ferngill ranged additions.
Manifest.Author: xSyy

Manifest.Name: Simple Ferngill Gear - Pistol Rendering
Manifest.Description: Ferngill pistol input, aiming alignment and magazine display.
Manifest.Author: xSyy
